stop.title: This counter cannot sell yet
stop.not_persistent: Chrome has not given this counter permanent storage, so it could delete unsynced bills. Install the POS app (the install icon in the address bar) and open it again. If this stays, call the manager.
stop.unavailable: The counter's database cannot be opened. Use current Chrome or Edge, close other POS windows, and reload. If this stays, call the manager.
stop.too_new: This counter's database was made by a newer version of the POS. Reload to get the newest version. Do not clear the browser's data.
stop.damaged: The counter's database is damaged. Do not clear the browser's data: call the manager, so unsynced bills can be saved.
stop.outbox_unreadable: The list of bills waiting to sync cannot be read. Do not clear the browser's data: call the manager.

setup.title: Set up this counter
setup.help: A manager creates a one-time code in the back office (Counters). Enter the shop code and that code.
setup.enrollment_failed: That code is wrong, used or expired. Ask the manager for a new one.
setup.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes, then try a new code.
setup.offline: Setting up needs the internet. Check the connection and try again.

unlock.title: Who is selling?
unlock.noStaff: No staff with a PIN yet. A manager gives each person a temporary PIN in the back office (Staff PINs).
unlock.wrong_one: Wrong PIN. {{count}} try left before you are locked on this counter.
unlock.wrong_other: Wrong PIN. {{count}} tries left before you are locked on this counter.
unlock.locked: Locked on this counter after 5 wrong PINs. Ask a manager to unlock you.
unlock.no_pin: You have no PIN yet. Ask a manager for a temporary PIN.
unlock.recorded: Every bill is recorded under the person who unlocked the counter.

choosePin.title: Choose your own PIN
choosePin.help: Your PIN was given by a manager. Choose your own: 4 to 6 digits that only you know.
choosePin.mismatch: The two PINs are not the same.
choosePin.offline: Saving your PIN needs the internet, so every counter learns it. You cannot sell until it is saved.
choosePin.wrong_pin: The temporary PIN was not accepted. Ask the manager for a new one.
choosePin.failed: Your PIN could not be saved. Ask the manager.

pinProblem.sequence: Do not use a run like 1234 or 4321.
pinProblem.is_short_code: Do not use your short code.

status.refused: The server does not accept this counter. Call the manager.

catalog.loading_one: Loading the catalog… {{count}} item so far
catalog.loading_other: Loading the catalog… {{count}} items so far
catalog.help: The first time, this counter downloads the whole catalog. Afterwards it searches without the internet.

search.label: Search
search.placeholder: Part name, code, OEM number or vehicle
search.hint: Type words of the part name in any order, a code, an OEM number, or a car and year: fan belt cultus · 17801 · brake pads corolla 2012.
search.none: No items match “{{text}}”. Try fewer words, or the OEM number.

bill.title: Bill
bill.soon: Adding items to a bill comes next. Search works now: try a code, an OEM number or a car and year.
